design: One fixed 256-row batch from every training shard, final joint checkpoint, training dropout, no optimizer updates. Same sampled rows for all seeds. Early calibration only for score and warning statistics.
limits: Descriptive final-checkpoint gradients, not training trajectories or causal identification. Raw gradients ignore Adam preconditioning and curvature. Row metrics have no IID intervals. No later calibration informs this diagnosis.

validation.limit: Checks the uploaded export and recorded provenance, not unavailable original raw payloads
